rules.source_query: demand_vs_capacity.kql -> AvailableCapacityNow() (native KQL, computed live from ERP nameplate + generator on/off status + current substation load)
rules.action: Recommend: start additional peakers, discharge BESS, initiate commercial demand response.

rules.description: Forecast 15% supply shortfall during peak evening hours
rules.source_query: predicted_deficits.kql -> ForecastGridBalance(240) (native KQL forecast via series_decompose_forecast, defined in phase3_native_scoring.kql)
rules.action: Recommend: schedule additional generation and/or a demand-response event ahead of peak.
Recommend: emergency redispatch; evaluate load-shed only if reserve margin breaches the hard threshold.

rules.description: Redistribute from surplus region to deficit region
rules.source_query: live_balance.kql grouped by region_id, gated on grid-wide stress
rules.action: Recommend: schedule inter-region transfer / redispatch from surplus region.

rules.description: Feeder loading exceeds 90% of thermal rating
rules.action: Recommend: field crew inspection and/or feeder load transfer.

rules.description: Critical facility customers on an outaged feeder
rules.action: Recommend: prioritize crew dispatch to restore feeder serving critical/medical customers.
